purpose: The OUTGOING disposition layer, snapshotted BEFORE the OI-333 repair regenerated it (the O-12 pattern, principle #16). It is the last successful derivation of that layer and the diff base ruling R4 requires.
why_it_is_taken: The repair escapes six invalid register patterns, which changes what the matchers match — a measured surface. R4 requires the regenerated layer to be diffed against this snapshot and every moved cluster explained, and a diff needs a base that cannot move under it.
what_is_here: The three emitted files of the disposition layer, byte-identical to the copies this wave found on disk.
